newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Moody's assigns A1 rating to KEPCO stg bond.
newsitem.headline: Moody's assigns A1 rating to KEPCO stg bond.

text.p: Moody's Investors Service said it has assigned an A1 long term debt rating to Korea Electric Power Corporation's (Kepco) 150 million stg bond issue due April 27, 2007.

Moody's said the rating reflected the strategic importance of the company to the South Korean economy, the supportive regulatory operating environment, its monoply status over transmission and distribution, and its strong operating performance.
KEPCO's debt protection measurement's were expected to remain strong, but would decline as the company continued to use debt to fund its construction programme, Moody's said.
